prompt: Create exactly ONE transparent game prop sprite. Reference 3 and 5 are approved final furniture style and localized wear. Reference 4 is the floor projection: orthographic, camera elevation45°, ground axes +/-0.7071, vertical edges vertical, tile144x101.82. Plan ground footprint BEFORE illustration; bottom contact corners must follow the template. Small top-down 3/4 view, two clear faces. Full object, generous transparent margins, NO floor/platform/pedestal/text/cast shadow. Upper-left light, restrained worn teal/ochre/cream/charcoal palette, modern industrial salvage society with repair/reuse, not medieval treasure nor nuclear wasteland. Readable at actual 144px grid scale, shape detail not photographic noise. A washing machine stainless drum repurposed as an open storage basket, small circular perforations simplified to grouped dark marks, rim lined with a frayed olive cloth, two small cloth bundles packed inside. Round footprint diameter.70tile, height28px at tile144, no complete washing machine. Full unsearched, broad gray painted metallic faces, no mirror chrome.
